scope: Emulator causal experiment; final production build and physical acceptance remain pending
method: Capture configured properties from each private library, queue both private unmount tasks before announcement, clear mounted/deadline state, and let native media registration schedule a new mount. Per-worker FIFO preserves task order.

observations.source_names: Five configured Nacho Chips names preserve case
observations.source_colors: Aqua on USB1/2/3/5, Default on USB4
observations.source_order: Native USB1/2 precede ordered HUB USB1 through USB5
observations.path_resolution: Early metadata mounts fail remote path resolution; post-retirement analysis mounts resolve to the matching registered source path

production_followup: Remove experimental branches, protect retirement with source admission, reset retirement state on removal/reuse, test bounded metadata fallback and repeat prevention, then verify exact non-diagnostic runtime and lifecycle/Link/eject regressions.
